indicator_assessments.name: Hyperscaler CapEx plateau (rate stabilizes)
indicator_assessments.description: Hyperscalers keep spending at enormous scale but STOP ACCELERATING — next-period guidance lands flat vs the prior baseline. This is the 'infrastructure is built' moment: a peak-confirmation signal, distinct from CapEx acceleration (t2_capex_parabolic, boom fuel) and from CapEx cuts (Tier 4, bust confirmation).
indicator_assessments.what_to_look_for: SCORING MODEL (v3.45.0, deterministic via the guidance ledger): per company (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META), latest print vs that company's OWN PRIOR FORWARD GUIDANCE — the signal is the SURPRISE, not the level. Points: RAISE >5% above prior guidance = -1 (accelerating). REITERATE/CONFIRM within ±5% = +1 (stable — merely confirming the number IS the event). CUT >5% = +2 (BEYOND plateau — 'we are done'). Withheld forward guidance after previously guiding = 0 points + watch flag (does NOT count toward the plateau tally). No print this cycle = 0, 'awaiting print'. STATUS IS DECIDED BY COUNT ALONE (ruling 2026-08-08): N = companies at stable-or-cutting: 0 = Not fired; 1-2 = Partially fired; 3-4 = Fired. Raises can never veto the count floor; cuts can never jump the band — the score S is INTENSITY display only. HARD RULE — qualifiers cannot override numbers: growth language attached to a reiterated number does NOT disqualify the plateau (forbidden escape, 2026-07-31: 'guidance is AT baseline, not flat'). WORKED EXAMPLE (Aug-7 prints): Meta stable +1 (2026 $130-145B reiterated within ±5% of prior), Microsoft stable +1 (accounting basis change: FY27 $175B vs $190B prior is a finance-to-operating lease reclassification, investment unchanged — ruled 2026-08-08, NOT an economic cut), Amazon accelerating -1 ($220B raise), Alphabet accelerating -1 (2027 guided above 2026) -> N=2, S=0 -> Partially fired. ENUMERATION HARD RULE: where-we-stand MUST list all four companies every day with stance, points, and last print date — 'awaiting print' when silent, never omitted.
